replies.author: MasterProX
replies.body: The first one is a normal mechanic in vanilla Minecraft, which is why shooting yourself to cover extra ground — or clear more air — is a somewhat popular tactic. The reasons that people gripe about it as much as they do, however, are mainly Avicus's server lag (entities with a delayed launch may sometimes strike the user from behind if they move forward before their action registers) and the way arrows interact with teammates (they bounce off players' hitboxes and often end up colliding with and damaging the original archer). The latter is a very common occurrence because players often stray in front of teammates who are aiming their bows. Fixing the second issue, as you said, should eliminate most of the complaints that don't arise because of lag.
